game.name: Left 4 Dead (USA, Europe)(En,Ja,Fr,De,Es,It,Pt,Zh,Ko,Pl,Ru)
game.desc: Left 4 Dead on Xbox 360 is a horrific FPS based largely on cooperation. Indeed, you play as one character in a group of four, but the other three can be led by friends. Escape the zombies by looking out for each other. To make things even more exciting, the game allows four other players to play as the undead and roam the city hunting down the heroes.
